comments.author: OldManJohnson
comments.body_html:
It’s both.

When removing mods with items, regardless of what the items are ….. you have to do several things.

  1. Delete the actual items. Everywhere. A single round of ammo forgotten in the pouch of some vest that’s 7 layers deep in cases will give you errors.

  2. Delete ANY saved weapon presets that have said mod items. The game will look for those things when you load the game without the mod and it will give you errors. Possibly even to the point of keeping the game from loading.

  3. Once you’ve done all that, then you delete the mod.

  4. If you get errors after doing the above, you missed something. You then need to reinstall that version of the mod and repeat steps 1-3 until no errors appear.

What you’re essentially doing is “scrubbing” your profile of any evidence the mod existed. This is why when I save a weapon preset, I always add a “zzz” to the beginning of the name. That way, I only need to search for names with that in it to more easily remove them when removing mods.

It also helps to label cases holding mod ammo in them. How you label them is up to you, but make it distinguishable using something the mod ammo has/does that vanilla ammo does not have/do. Same with gear, weapons, etc.

It all sounds tedious, but I guarantee you that it will save you a TON of headaches if/when you need to remove the associated mod(s).

comments.author: hellchickens
comments.body_html:
Remove mod from folder, then go to SPT\SPT_Data\configs\core.json and change

"fixProfileBreakingInventoryItemIssues": false,

to true, start spt server, it will automatically clean up all missing and broken items from ur inventory. Works in 99% of situations fine. If game loading and u don’t see errors in both client and server then stop server and revert config back to false, install that mod instead of old. If profile corrupts u can find previous backup in SPT\user\profiles\backups , it’s done every time u turn on spt server.

P.S. without tons of manual work u can’t have old and new mod installed as there are tons of same ID’s and nobody can tell u how it will be handled (and nobody wants to waste here any time for sure)

comments.author: Massivesoft
comments.body_html: Flesh and steel were once cleaved by an unbroken line—one mortal, one forged, one bound to blood, the other to flame. But in Tarkov, that land devoured by ceaseless war, the sacred boundary bleeds and blurs. And so, through rites most ancient and unhallowed, the veil between sinew and alloy is torn asunder. Thus may one cast flesh as one casts iron, and cultivate steel as one cultivates living tissue. Wherefore the Propital syringe—that vessel bred to mend the broken body, to call life back from the abyss—is now profaned and repurposed: its ichor turned to quench the thirst of blackened barrels, its plasmic essence annealed to swell the stature of guns, that they might grow monstrous and terrible beyond mortal ken.
